BiblicalUsage: Elimelek is an Israelite. In Ruth 1:2, the text says "And the name of the man [was] Elimelech." The life behind the name is told on the Elimelech People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elimelek matters because God knows His people by name, and Elimelek is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
